currentVersion.title: Clean Live TV Return, Guaranteed First-Try Channel Play & VOD Seek Engine
currentVersion.releaseNotes:
• Clean Return to Live TV: Returning to Live TV from Movies, Series, or any other module now cleanly restores the 'Select a channel on the left to start streaming' message on the preview screen, with zero leftover VOD titles or lingering playback frames
• Guaranteed First-Try Channel Playback: Clicking any channel now immediately begins streaming on the first press — eliminated the issue where the previous channel state blocked playback and required navigating down and up to register
• Complete Media State Reset: ExoPlayerManager stop() now thoroughly purges stream URLs, titles, and live playback tokens upon leaving modules, ensuring Live TV starts from a pristine preview state
• Scrubbing Throttle & Debounce: Remote fast-forward and rewind scrubbing now debounces network Range requests by 350ms while keeping real-time UI magnitude feedback (+30s, +1m) — completely preventing the burst of aborted HTTP requests that caused 'Connection interrupted (HTTP error)' crashes when seeking
• Fast VOD Playback Startup: Optimized loadControl buffer thresholds (800ms initial buffer) for instant startup on Hulu, FX, and high-bitrate series like 'The Drop'
• Failsafe Auto-Reboot & Resume: If an unrecoverable stream error occurs after all retries, the app automatically executes an internal media engine reboot and seamlessly returns to programming at the exact saved playback position without requiring a manual reboot

releases.title: Seamless Cross-Module Preview & Consistent VOD Fullscreen Play/Pause
releases.releaseNotes:
• Cross-Module Preview Continuity: Fixed YouTube player teardown so Music and Podcasts preview smoothly across all modules without blank screens or audio loss
• In-Place Video Loading: Reused active YouTube WebView with loadVideoById for instant, fluid song and episode transitions
• Universal Live TV Preview: Preview card in Live TV now expands whichever media is currently active (Music, Podcasts, VOD, or Live TV)
• VOD Fullscreen Play/Pause Fix: Direct DPAD Center, Enter, and Select interception on key-down prevents focus loss to HUD overlay cards, ensuring rock-solid play/pause toggling
• Prioritized Remote Media Keys: Dedicated play/pause and seek keys consistently control active VOD and Live streams without misrouting to dormant YouTube WebViews
• Debounce Lockout Removal: Removed initial 1-second key lockout on native player mount for immediate remote responsiveness

releases.title: Preview System Overhaul — Seamless Cross-Module Continuity
releases.releaseNotes:
• Cross-Tab Preview Continuity: YouTube music and podcast audio now persists in the preview pane when browsing Movies or Series — no more audio cutoff when switching between content modules
• Smart Media Handoff: Switching from native content (Live TV, Movies, Series) to YouTube tabs now cleanly stops ExoPlayer before transitioning, preventing stale video frames from bleeding into the YouTube preview
• Consistent Play/Pause Remote Key: Eliminated double-fire issue where DPAD Center toggled play/pause twice in VOD and Live TV fullscreen — now correctly handled once by Compose
• VOD Black Screen Fix: Fullscreen movie and series player now aggressively reclaims the render surface on mount, guaranteeing picture immediately with no black flash
• Preview Display Priority Fixed: YouTube preview now correctly appears when ExoPlayer stream URL is cleared, regardless of transient buffering state flags
• YouTube WebView Persistence: Improved WebView lifecycle to survive tab switches and fullscreen transitions without reload or re-buffering

releases.title: YouTube Curation & Remote Fixes, Fluid Preview Persistence & Consistent Play/Pause
releases.releaseNotes:
• YouTube Music & Podcast Curation: Strictly isolated genre matching prevents unrelated artist leakage (e.g. Taylor Swift in Hip-Hop/Rap) and aligns podcast categories accurately
• Fluid YouTube Fullscreen-to-Preview: Exiting fullscreen to preview now continues playing seamlessly without pausing or black screen, with instant playback auto-resume
• YouTube Fullscreen Remote Navigation: Restored TV remote DPAD Up (previous) and Down (next) video navigation across Music and Podcasts in fullscreen
• Consistent Remote Play/Pause: Standardized DPAD Center / Select / Enter key handling across Live TV, VOD, and YouTube in fullscreen with zero missed inputs and no accidental pauses on launch
• VOD Black Screen Elimination: Decoupled preview rendering surface during fullscreen playback, guaranteeing instant picture display for all movies and series
• Always-On Persistent Preview: Removed toggle from Settings and permanently enforced persistent preview across all tabs and navigation

releases.title: Universal Integrated Preview, Seamless Fullscreen Transition & Vertical Categories
releases.releaseNotes:
• Universal Playback Persistence: Playback across all modules (Live TV, Movies, Series, Music, Podcasts) now continues seamlessly in the preview window across all modules when pressing Back or switching tabs until stopped with 'X' or new content is selected — no module is master of the preview
• Integrated Preview Design: Replaced floating PiP overlay with dedicated 16:9 integrated preview situated directly above the 280dp category sidebar in Live TV, Movies, Series, Music, and Podcasts
• Seamless Fullscreen Transition: Removed stream recovery on fullscreen toggle, allowing instant fullscreen expansion without re-preparing the stream or causing a buffer delay
• Music & Podcasts Vertical Categories: Redesigned TV layout for Music and Podcasts with dedicated 280dp category sidebar and integrated preview matching Live TV, Movies, and Series
• True Black Dark Themes: Midnight Classic, Obsidian Bento, and Cyber Stage themes now feature pure black (#000000) backgrounds across the entire Android app

releases.title: Universal Preview Dock & True Black Dark Themes
releases.releaseNotes:
• Universal Preview Persistence: Hitting Back or Close on any module (Movies, Series, Podcasts) now docks active content into the floating preview window instead of stopping it — no module is master of the preview
• Podcast Audio-Mode Preview: When a podcast is docked, the preview stage switches to a compact artwork + title + animated waveform display instead of an empty black rectangle
• Embed VOD Persistence: Embed-based movie and series players (iframe) now transfer into the preview dock when closing details, keeping the stream alive
• Smart Expand Button: Tapping the expand arrow on a docked podcast reopens the episode in the Podcasts module; VOD content returns to its details view
• True Black App Background: Midnight Classic, Obsidian Bento, and Cyber Stage themes now use #000000 body background for a deeper, more immersive look

releases.title: Live TV Frame Fix, Seek Error Recovery & Stale Listener Cleanup
releases.releaseNotes:
• VOD Frame on Live TV (Root Fix): Resolved lingering VOD video frames when returning to Live TV by fully clearing player state before tab transition, then unconditionally wiping the video frame — first live channel now plays correctly without requiring channel up/down
• HTTP Seek Error Recovery: Replaced single retry with 5 progressive reconnect attempts (increasing delays) at current seek position before giving up; after exhausting retries, a 12-second watchdog auto-reloads the stream from the beginning so the player self-recovers without a manual reboot
• Stale Event Listener Fix: Eliminated stall/stalled listener accumulation across stream sessions — previous sessions' listeners are now explicitly removed before a new stream starts, preventing ghost play() calls from firing on live TV after VOD playback
• Retry Count Reset: vodErrorRetryCount is now reset on every new stream start and full player reset, preventing stale counts from one title affecting recovery of the next

releases.title: Live TV Frame Clearance & Hulu Series Playback Stall Recovery
releases.releaseNotes:
• Live TV Screen Transition: Completely cleared lingering VOD video frames when navigating back to Live TV, ensuring previous movie or series content does not remain on screen
• Hulu & Series Playback Stalling Fix: Resolved perpetual pause on Hulu series (e.g. 'The Drop') with proactive autoplay priming, explicit user-pause state tracking, muted autoplay retry, and automatic stall recovery nudging

releases.title: Seek Bar Overlay, Smooth VOD & Codec Fix, In-App Reboot & Subtitles
releases.releaseNotes:
• Seek Bar HUD on Remote Scrubbing: Fast-forward and rewind remote controls immediately display a temporary 3-second seek bar with time stamps and scrub magnitude badge (+15s, -30s, etc.) without obscuring playback
• Clean In-App Reboot: Restored quick in-process app reboot recycling and activity restart, resolving launcher exit issue on modern Google TV and Android 12+
• Clean Startup Preview: App startup now displays a clean preview placeholder with 'Select a channel to start streaming' instead of spinning buffering indicators
• Google TV Audio Compatibility & VOD Stability: Fixed perpetual pause on Hulu/FX/Fox/ABC titles (such as 'The Drop: A Snowfall Saga') by decoding multi-channel audio directly to PCM and increasing buffer thresholds for smooth, uninterrupted playback
• Non-Intrusive Buffering HUD: Removed dark screen dimming and large center circles during buffering; video picture remains fully visible beneath a sleek corner indicator
• VOD Search Video Card Auto-Focus: Selecting a Movie or Series search result scrolls and directly focuses the target video card in its parent category
• Settings Simplification: Removed obsolete Smart Personalization option
• YouTube Closed Captions Fix: Added reactive settings state and fixed asynchronous captions module loading with English language preference in YouTube player

releases.title: VOD Search Category Routing, Playback Stall Fix & Full App Restart
releases.releaseNotes:
• Live TV Search Bar Focus: Cleaned up Live TV search bar on focus by removing the redundant 'OK TO SEARCH' badge for a cleaner, modern look

• VOD Decoder Auto-Recovery & 4K Crash Protection: Fixed decoding failed reconnect stalls by auto-advancing past corrupt keyframes and refreshing hardware codec surfaces; reduced backBuffer to 20s to eliminate 4K out-of-memory crashes

• YouTube Music remote navigation: D-Pad Up (Previous) & Down (Next) with on-screen button
